name: cluster-review-intelligence
description: Cluster-level review analytics for Uttarakhand tourism: aspect-based sentiment on Hinglish reviews, competitive benchmarking and trend detection. AI–Tourism Hackathon 2026 (G5).

paragraphs: Review intelligence for hotel and homestay owners. When a property's reviews get worse on some aspect, is that this property's problem or the whole market's? A single hotel cannot answer that from its own reviews. Its cluster of nearby competitors can. The system tells an owner where they lag their local cluster, since when, and whose problem it is, from reviews written in English, romanised Hindi (Hinglish) or Devanagari.

Twenty seconds, on SYNTHETIC data. Property F's Food sentiment falls in 2025-06. The plain before-and-after is −1.21; the market moved +0.01 over the same months; so −1.22 is this property's alone. Then the three kinds of verdict a decline can get — yours alone, everyone's, your neighbourhood's — and one Hinglish review splitting into Food +1 and Room −1. Every figure is read from the bundled snapshot; none is computed for the clip.
Full quality, with a scrubber: demoSYNTHETIC.mp4 · poster frame.
